name: Website Builders
intro: Website builders host your site and give you templates and a visual editor, so you can publish without writing code. They split into all-round builders (Wix, Squarespace, WordPress.com, Jimdo, GoDaddy), design-led builders for marketers and designers (Webflow, Framer), store-first platforms (Shopify), hosting companies with a builder included (Hostinger) and one-page tools (Carrd). Prices are per website, and the first-term price is not always what you pay at renewal.
buyingTips: Check the renewal price: Hostinger's Premium plan costs $1.99 a month for the first term, then renews at $10.99 a month. Wix, Webflow, WordPress.com, Framer and Shopify show one price with no first-term discount.
The free domain lasts one year only. After that it renews at the registrar's standard rate, which none of these builders prints on its pricing page.
Selling online? Compare transaction fees as well as the plan price: Shopify Basic adds 2% on sales through third-party payment providers, and Webflow's Ecommerce Standard plan charges 2%.
Multi-year terms cut the price further on some builders: WordPress.com Personal is $9 billed monthly, $4 a month billed yearly and $2.75 a month on a 3-year term.
Free plans put your site on the builder's own subdomain with its branding (wixsite.com, wordpress.com, webflow.io, carrd.co). Pay for a plan before you buy a custom domain.

featureLabels.freeDomain: Free domain for the first year

faqs.a: For a one-page site, Carrd Pro Standard costs $19 a year for 10 sites with custom domains. For a full site, WordPress.com Personal costs $4 a month on yearly billing, and Hostinger's Premium plan costs $1.99 a month for the first term but renews at $10.99 a month.

faqs.q: Do website builders raise the price after the first year?
faqs.a: Some do. Hostinger's builder plans renew at about 5 to 6 times the first-term price. Wix, Webflow, WordPress.com, Framer, Shopify and Carrd list one price with no intro discount, but the free domain included with annual plans renews at the standard domain rate after year one.

useCases.name: Website Builders for Ecommerce
useCases.intro: Every builder here can run an online store with a built-in cart and checkout on at least one plan. Check which plan adds selling and what transaction fee it charges.
useCases.ruleText: Has a built-in online store on at least one plan.

useCases.name: Website Builders with a Free Domain
useCases.singular: website builder with a free domain
useCases.intro: These builders include a custom domain free for the first year when you pay annually. The domain then renews at the standard rate, so budget for it from year two.
useCases.ruleText: Includes a free custom domain for the first year on an annual plan.

useCases.name: Cheap Website Builders (Under $10 a Month)
useCases.intro: These builders have a paid plan that costs $10 a month or less on yearly billing. Hostinger's price is for the first term only; check each one's renewal price.
useCases.ruleText: The paid entry plan costs $10/month or less on annual billing.
